# teams_meeting_policy_group_assignment (Resource)

Assigns a MeetingPolicy instance to an Entra group, with a rank among the type's group assignments, via Grant-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Group.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Assign a custom meeting policy to an Entra group. A user in several groups gets
# the policy of the group with the lowest rank. Teams keeps ranks dense (1..n per
# policy type), so give each group of the type its own rank.
resource "teams_meeting_policy" "restricted" {
  identity       = "RestrictedExternal"
  allow_meet_now = false
}

resource "teams_meeting_policy_group_assignment" "contractors" {
  group_id    = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000" # Entra group object ID
  policy_name = teams_meeting_policy.restricted.identity
  rank        = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) Object id of the Entra group the policy is assigned to. Changing it forces replacement.
- `policy_name` (String) Name of the TeamsMeetingPolicy instance to assign to the group.
- `rank` (Number) One-based rank among the group assignments of TeamsMeetingPolicy; a user in several groups gets the policy of the lowest rank. Teams keeps ranks dense: assigning another group at an occupied rank shifts this one, which shows up as drift. A rank beyond the number of group assignments is placed last: the apply warns and the difference shows up as drift until the lower ranks exist, and re-applying a rank that stays beyond that number fails.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Assignment identifier (the group's object id).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The import ID is the Entra group's object ID.
terraform import teams_meeting_policy_group_assignment.contractors 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
